client_host.measurement_location: HTTP client executes on this host; engine location is parent-provided metadata

metadata.sample_policy: first three independent original decode jobs; no score retries
metadata.ordering: prose AB/BA/AB, code AB/BA/AB, then generic prefill A/B
metadata.prefill_public_result_limit: original median-rate row and sample counts, not all attempts

engine_identity.identity_source: resident_engine_identity RPC plus resident state file API PID

draft_sampling.draft_scale_per_pos_uses: global draft_scale multiplied by relative[position]; omitted positions use global draft_scale

residual_sampling.candidate_set: Top-64 target candidates union the rejected draft token

phase_profiling_enabled.reason: requires actual QWEN38_ROUND_PROFILE external hooks, an owner/helper round ring, probabilistic drafts, standard rejection, PIECEWISE/NONE graphs and synchronous scheduling
phase_profiling_enabled.cost: samples attached phase CUDA events and host ranges one in 16 calls; configuration records and completion-checks all event handles with per-device stream synchronization; decode T_round classifies requests from CPU BatchReqState.is_prefilling_np and scheduled_spec_decode_tokens; owner/helper timings are current-stream marker intervals, not total work; no generation synchronization

prose_draft_top_k.cost: filters proposal logits and the same cached q before sampling only for all-positive-temperature batches; target sampling stays unchanged

prose_residual_top_k.reason: requires the resident residual Top-64 patch, standard rejection, PIECEWISE/NONE graphs and synchronous scheduling
prose_residual_top_k.cost: uses Top-64(target) union the rejected draft token only when target_top_k <= 64; otherwise falls back to full-vocabulary residual sampling

qad_hot_cache_enabled.reason: loaded peer_worker is not using native QAD

target_only.cost: bypasses all MTP proposal work between requests; target weights, logits and sampling parameters stay unchanged

prose_draft_head_mode.preparation: BF16 is prepared once through the existing MTP builder from the private INT4 head's selected source rows; no target-head or checkpoint replacement
prose_draft_head_mode.request_policy: BF16 proposals are forwarded only for all-positive-temperature batches; greedy and mixed batches remain INT4

compact_draft_head_enabled.reason: MTP compute_logits is the legacy private-head path, not full BF16 mode
compact_draft_head_enabled.preparation: first enable copies exact selected rows from the loaded dense BF16 MTP lm_head on its owner device; no INT4 requantization or model reload
compact_draft_head_enabled.request_policy: applies to every workload; positive-temperature draft_scale is preserved and standard rejection remains required

draft_scale_per_pos.value_contract: null restores global draft_scale; each positive finite entry is a relative multiplier at the zero-based draft position; omitted positions use global draft_scale
draft_scale_per_pos.request_policy: all-positive-temperature batches only; greedy and mixed batches are unchanged

code_draft_tokens.reason: requires the q11 greedy-depth runner field in 1..Kmax, the resident valid-depth patch, standard rejection, PIECEWISE/NONE graphs and synchronous scheduling
code_draft_tokens.request_policy: nonempty all-zero-temperature batches only; prose, mixed and empty batches are unchanged

prose_confidence_threshold.cost: computes draft q top-1 probability and synchronizes once after each draft step; disabled by default

ple_madvise.cost: changes only existing file mapping advice between requests; does not pin or modify weights

ple_gather_fast_rows.cost: changes only the serial/parallel threshold of the existing gather executor between requests; no table or executor recreation

phase_profiling.reason: requires the optional source patch to install real phase begin/end hooks

draft_head.byte_scope: head matrix weights only; excludes temporary preparation buffers and Marlin workspace

scale.value_scope: configured value only; status does not prove private-head output application
scale.application_evidence_required: Q7 runtime output comparison for both INT4 and BF16 head paths

draft_head.source_quality_scope: BF16 reconstructs the same selected MTP proposal rows through the existing _dv_build; proposal-only, with target logits, target head and target weights unchanged
draft_head.request_policy: all-positive-temperature batches may use the configured mode; greedy and mixed batches use INT4

compact_draft_head.byte_scope: prepared BF16 selected matrix plus persistent int64 IDs; excludes temporary preparation buffers and full MTP lm_head
compact_draft_head.unsupported_reason: MTP compute_logits is the legacy private-head path, not full BF16 mode

qad_hot_cache.reason: loaded peer_worker is not using native QAD

acceptance_metrics.available_via: resident API server /metrics; read before and after each experiment

ple_mmap.scope: existing file-backed mappings only; no tensor or hash changes

ple_gather.scope: mutates only fast_rows on already-loaded registered MmapPleTable objects; does not recreate tables, alter weights/headers/hash state, or claim pinning

process.units: kB memory fields are converted to bytes; other counters retain proc units

gather_counters.reset_note: _stats_log resets windowed fields; compare only within one unchanged window

ple_observation.scope: read-only mincore and proc snapshots of existing file-backed PLE mappings; page-cache residency is not RAM pinning

limitations.prefill_public_result: One median-rate row per size plus samples/samplesRequested counts; the pinned source does not expose individual attempt results. Errors/notices exposed by the public job are preserved without reconstruction.
limitations.cached_tokens_zero_means: Upstream uses 0 for unknown/none; 0 alone does not prove absence of a prefix-cache hit. Parent fresh server configuration is separate evidence.
